reviews.comment: GO TO CLASS! She expects you to watch her online theory lectures for the quizzes so she can use the class time for practice problem worksheets. These will appear in your homework/tests. We complete them together in class, but then leaves 1-2 problems for us to do individually that will be graded as extra credit. There is a fairly easy group project

She is a fantastic and caring professor. Class is not hard, would highly recommend coming to class each day, and taking notes to be successful. The biggest grade in the class is the Group project near the end of the semester, and gives out lots of extra credit in class.

Quizzes (5) are insanely hard, but exams (2) are manageable. 5 homeworks. Tests were in person but open note. Attendance is not required, but tests come from in class activities and she gives extra credit almost everyday! SO GO TO CLASS! Overall, she is a great option. If you care, she cares! Very accessible. I would take her again!

Dr. Winston is outstanding! She includes her students, listens, and is extremely personable. She gives TONS of extra credit in class, so show up. There's a pretty big group project and a lot of homework/quizzes, but if you do the work, this class will be easy. Her exams are pretty difficult, but that's just the nature of finance.

She is an absolutely amazing professor! The material she teaches may be hard to understand, but she is happy to explain concepts over again, and she is very easy to contact outside of class. She expects you to put the work in, but she helps you every step on the way. She is a wonderful person, I wish I had more classes with her!

If you show up youll make an A! Great professor! She is very nice and gives amazing reviews before test!
